title: Matt Besser: Pot Humor
description: Matt Besser performs at the North West Cannabis Club in Portland, Oregon.

title: Marc Maron: Thinky Pain
description: Marc Maron discusses everything from pornography to religion.

title: Andy Sandford: &y S&ford
description: Andy Sandford dives into the absurd side of life, tackling pharmacists losing their jobs, full-sized houses on the move, and clowns on the edge. Smart, dry, and brutally funny-this is stand-up for people who notice how weird the world really is.

title: D.L. Hughley: Clear
description: The comic performs in San Francisco, discussing current affairs and nosy neighbors at the Regency Theater.

title: D.L. Hughley: Reset
description: The comic performs.

title: Dov Davidoff: Lower Your Expectations
description: The comic performs in Chicago.

title: Eddie Pence's (Un)Special Comedy Special
description: Comic Eddie Pence performs his hilarious stand-up routine.

title: Ezequiel Campa: Live and on Weed
description: The Argentine comedian explores various topics.

title: Jasmine Ellis: Black Girl Panic
description: Jasmine Ellis reflects on the formative experiences that formed her adulthood; to the delight of a full house in Austin, Texas, Ellis looks back at her parents, experiences in a mental hospital and interracial marriage as a Texan.

title: Jenny McCarthy's Dirty Sexy Funny
description: Female comedians Paula Bel, Tiffany Haddish, Lynne Koplitz, Justine Marino and Tammy Pescatelli join Jenny McCarthy to shed some light on what it's really like to be a woman.

title: Jill-Michele Meleán: White/Latina
description: Jill-Michele Meleán is not white enough to play the Stepford wife or Latin enough to play the gangsta, but she's relatable to all ethnicities.

title: Joey Coco Diaz: Sociably Unacceptable
description: The comic performs.

title: Kai Choyce: Kaipocalypse Now
description: Kai delves into female orgasms as a porn category, how bigots need to pick a lane, the 2011 TV movie "Cyberbully," and plenty of other topics.

title: Kevin Hart Presents: Keith Robinson Back of the Bus Funny
description: Keith Robinson describes the long-term dangers of being racist, the pitfalls of aging and the difference between the ways that men and women cheat.

title: Kevin Hart Presents: Plastic Cup Boyz
description: Stand-up comics Joey Wells, Will Horton and Na'im Lynn make up the Plastic Cup Boyz, who have opened for Kevin Hart for many years, but now they step into the spotlight with headlining sets of their own.

title: Kevin Hart Presents: Lil Rel Howery: RELevent
description: Comic Lil Rel Howery explains how he found out that his father wasn't a doctor; the difference between raising a son and a daughter; racism within the black community.

title: Tom Segura: Completely Normal
description: Comedian Tom Segura opens up about hotels, his hobbies and digestive ailments.

title: Sinbad: Where U Been?
description: The comic performs at the Club Nokia Theatre in Los Angeles.

title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

title: Jimmy O. Yang: Good Deal
description: From the Neptune Theater in Seattle, the comic talks about his interactions with immigrant parents, gives his thoughts on Matt Damon and asks whether ghosts are likely to haunt one-bedroom apartments.

title: Kylie Brakeman: Linda Hollywood's Big Night
description: Character comedian Kylie Brakeman teaches an acting masterclass as Linda Hollywood, a problematic, old school talent agent on a mission to spread her industry wisdom-and save her own career in the process.

title: Jim Gaffigan: Noble Ape
description: Comic Jim Gaffigan proves that laughter is the best medicine when he talks about a family medical crisis and other topics during his hilarious stand-up routine.

title: Steve Trevino: 'Til Death
description: Texas is home to barbecue, the Alamo and comic Steve Trevino.

title: Billy Gardell: Halftime
description: Billy rants about modern life -- everything from new medicine and hand sanitizers to the rules of marriage, parenting and technology overload.

title: Eddie Griffin: Undeniable
description: The comic celebrates a 30-year anniversary in comedy by discussing the world, relationships and humanity.

title: Eddie Griffin: You Can Tell Em I Said It
description: Eddie shares his thoughts on his love for Michelle Obama, God's sense of humor, who really makes up the Tea Party, and why Cleveland should get over LeBron James.

title: Hal Sparks: Charmageddon
description: The comic discusses differences between men and women, country folks and non-smokers.

title: Jose Velasquez Hoozay: The Salvadoran
description: Comedian Jose Hoozay Velasquez rises from performing in his mom's backyard to becoming a comedic force to be reckoned with.

title: Kathleen Madigan: Madigan Again
description: Kathleen Madigan performs comedy in Detroit.

title: Kevin James Thornton: Be Yourself
description: Kevin James Thornton takes the audience on a journey about growing up gay in a strict church community, trying to be popular in school, and the relatable stories we all share trying to fit into our own skin.

title: Leanne Morgan: So Yummy
description: Leanne Morgan gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs, and cheerleading camp.

title: Mike E. Winfield: StepMan
description: The comic explains the challenges of marrying an older woman and being a stepfather to a son who shares similar qualities as him, women who consider "everything" as cheating, and an idea for a divorce app.

title: Paul Rodriguez: The Here and Wow
description: Veteran comedian, Paul Rodriguez hits the stage to give his perspectives on life, from being peer pressured into believing in God to claiming to be the village idiot.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
description: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
description: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

title: Whitney Cummings: Money Shot
description: One of the funniest comics on television.

title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
description: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

title: Sinbad: Make Me Wanna Holla
description: Comic Sinbad discusses the life advice his family gave him; why he's tired of people with no talent having clothing lines; who he really is.

title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
description: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

title: Jimmy O. Yang: Guess How Much?
description: Yang dives into love languages, loser friends and negotiating with his Asian parents.

title: John Beuhler: Inappropriate
description: The first no-holds-barred stand-up set from John Beuhler.

title: Jim Gaffigan: Quality Time
description: The comic uses his signature everyman humor to deal with the unthinkable; filmed at the State Theatre in Minneapolis.

title: Danny Martinello: Starting Sober
description: Danny Martinello's debut special dedicated to those who had his back when he decided to put down the bottle.

title: Erik Rivera: I'm No Expert
description: Comedian Erik Rivera showcases his act as he riffs on relationships, fatherhood and his eccentric extended family.

title: J-L Cauvin: Half Blackface
description: Comedian J-L Cauvin addresses growing up the son of mixed-race parents and how the pandemic turned out to be his superhero origin story.

title: John Crist: I Got Questions
description: The debut comedy special from award-winning standup comic John Crist is a joyride of non-stop merriment with his wit and feel-good comedic sensibility.

title: Keep Your Distance
description:
S01 E04 — Vol. 4
Tony Baker; DC Ervin; Canice; Chinedu Unaka; Jackie Fabulous; Trevor Wallace.

title: The Kims of Comedy
description: Four Asian comics riff on a variety of pop culture topics, from Christmas to Korea and everything in between.

title: Lucas Waterfill: Public Inconvenience
description: Lucas performs his unique brand of standup in his first comedy special.

title: Matt Besser: Besser Breaks the Record
description: Matt Besser airs some grievances and tries to break some records at the U.C.B. Theater in Hollywood.

title: Lavell Crawford: New Look Same Funny! (Extended Edition)
description: Lavell Crawford, with a new look and new outlook on life, hosts a new standup special.

title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
description: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy
description: The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.

title: Jeff Dunham: I'm With Cupid
description: Ventriloquist and stand-up comedian Jeff Dunham performs an all-Valentine's Day-themed special.

title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
description: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
description: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
description: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
description: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

title: Logan Guntzelman: Boner Technology
description: Logan Guntzelman shares with an Atlanta crowd tales of her dating app standards, moving in with a boyfriend, and upgrades in male health technology.

title: Willie Barcena: The Truth Hurts
description: Performing live in El Paso, Texas, veteran comedian Willie Barcena tells it like it is, from questioning God to marrying a woman with large feet.

title: William Lee Martin: Standing in the Middle
description: The Texas comic talks about life, marriage, raising five children and living in a country that's in a constant state of flux.

title: Tom Arnold: Past & Present Imperfectly
description: From meat packer to movie star, a review of Tom Arnold's career and present life.

title: Tim Minchin: So F...king Rock Live!
description: Join the darkly humorous, rock star-esque Mr Minchin for a night of stand-up and music - no subject is taboo; sex, God, death and even Darwinism are all covered! Filmed at London's Bloomsbury Theatre.

title: Susan Rice: Silver Alert
description: With decades of stand-up experience under her belt, Susan Rice takes the stage to share quips about car troubles and the joys of getting older.

title: Tahir Moore: Aging Out
description: Tahir Moore brings high-energy, no-filter comedy in a wild ride through the zombie apocalypse, fancy toilets, naps, and aging; self-roasting, brutally honest, and always hilarious-this is stand-up with zero chill, big laughs, and all heart.

title: Shayne Smith: Alligator Boys
description: Comedian Shayne Smith shares stories about everything from a failed robbery to a wrestling match in the New York Subway and even saving the life of a dog in this stand-up special.

title: Shayne Smith: Prison for Wizards
description: Comedian and former gang member, Shayne Smith performs in a stand-up special.

title: Saul Trujillo: Yolanda
description: Does "Variety's top comic to watch" look like Selena's murderer? Find out why cruises are terrible, and the homeless tent problem isn't the problem one thinks it is.
